workflow: A stateful object stores a borrowed pointer to a mutable value without acquiring ownership.
A user-controlled operation re-enters the update routine and replaces that value, releasing the previously referenced object.
The outer update resumes with the stale borrowed pointer and uses it for further computation.
The access reaches freed memory, causing a use-after-free instead of completing the state update safely.
summary: Reentrant replacement invalidates a borrowed state pointer
